name: robotics/safety-authority
definition: Subject may issue e-stops and geofence changes.
title: Safety authority
description: Required for ATEP-R safety commands other than an e-stop accepted from a safety-certified fleet-member.
subject: Agent ID of the authority
attestation-schema:
attestation = {
  subject: agent-id,
  issuer: agent-id,                      ; MUST equal the envelope signer
  claim: uri,
  data: { * tstr => any },
  ? evidence: bstr .size 32,
  ? evidence-uri: uri,
  id: bstr .size 16,
}
agent-id = bstr .size 32
uri = tstr
lifetime: 30 to 180 days by default, 400 days at most
